description: Structured proof of a bank transfer attached to a funding or payment declaration (non-custodial model, RFC-002/003, architecture v1.2 D15). The evidence IS the data (clave de rastreo, banks, date, amount, hash) — a PDF/screenshot is only an optional attachment because CEPs can be regenerated at Banxico from the data and screenshots are forgeable. Evidence hierarchy: clave de rastreo → official CEP validation → screenshot. Named Transfer (not Payment) evidence because tomorrow it covers SPEI, CoDi, Open Finance, ACH or wire.

fields.name: subjectType
fields.description: What the evidence belongs to. Allowed values: FUNDING, PAYMENT.

fields.name: subjectId
fields.description: fundingTransactions.fundingId or loanPayments.paymentId depending on subjectType.

fields.name: claveRastreo
fields.description: SPEI tracking key, format ^[A-Za-z0-9]{10,30}$. UNIQUE per company — one real transfer can only back one declaration (natural idempotency).

fields.name: bancoOrigen
fields.description: Sending bank as reported by the payer.

fields.name: cepValidado
fields.description: True when a PaymentProvider (manual support review, Banxico CEP, STP) validated the transfer. Defaults to false.

fields.name: validationProvider
fields.description: Which provider validated. Allowed values: manual, banxico_cep, stp. Defaults to manual.

fields.name: evidenceHash
fields.description: SHA-256 of claveRastreo|bancoOrigen|bancoDestino|fechaOperacion|montoMXN — tamper-evidence over the structured data.

fields.name: attachmentBlobUrl
fields.description: OPTIONAL receipt file in a PRIVATE Azure Blob container (short-lived SAS). Never the source of truth.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.

components.name: TransferEvidenceListStep
components.description: IonList newest-first by companyId: claveRastreo, subjectType chip, montoMXN, fechaOperacion, cepValidado badge (✓ green when validated, with validationProvider).

hints: UNIQUE constraint on (companyId, claveRastreo) — duplicate declaration of the same transfer must return error 409-style with the existing evidenceId.
Extra action 'validate_result': sets cepValidado + validationProvider after a PaymentProvider verdict — the ONLY allowed update; all other fields are immutable after insert.
